question: Do stronger isolated starting-Compute changes materially compress the persistent Demis Hassabis and Elon Musk faction extremes without creating new faction or strategy dominance?

selectionRule.imperialCandidate: Prefer 1 starting Compute if it materially compresses Demis at two through four players while leaving the faction competitive at five and six.
selectionRule.verticalCandidate: Prefer 5 starting Compute if it materially improves Elon across player counts without creating a leading faction cell.
selectionRule.independence: Each candidate is compared only with canonical on common seeds. Either, both, or neither may be selected; a selected combination requires confirmation.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: Neither arm establishes human counterplay, negotiation quality, duration, perceived fairness, or fun.
